transfer_protocol.mutation: sender release and recipient acquisition are published as one Store claim batch guarded by the expected claim generation
transfer_protocol.fencing: the source release is version n+1 and recipient hold is n+2; a competing transfer that loses the generation CAS cannot publish a second owner
transfer_protocol.retry: stable transfer request identity and payload digest allow a caller to reconcile an interrupted publication by reading the exact release/recipient pair
transfer_protocol.lease: transfer preserves the existing bounded lease origin and does not restart its TTL

crash_matrix.reopened_state: source is the sole effective owner
the test accepts either source or recipient as the sole effective owner; retry reconciles to recipient
recipient is the sole effective owner

concurrency.result: only one competing recipient is admitted

validation.store_kind: isolated test-owned EmbeddedStore fixtures; this result is not canonical Store publication proof

live_claim_liveness_observation.authority: read-only Environment claims explain through canonical Store transport
live_claim_liveness_observation.action: no recovery, transfer, test, merge, or checkout mutation was attempted

readiness: Atomic claim transfer and interruption recovery pass the focused isolated-store suite. Canonical Store transfer is not asserted here. Compiler and Forge remain protected until their authenticated owner handoffs are received.
